# Compaction boundary p=1: distinct INT64 and constant FLOAT64; retain 4 executions per n.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(n, trial, TO_HEX(si) AS int_hex, TO_HEX(sf) AS float_hex) ORDER BY n, trial)
FROM (
  SELECT n, trial, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1) AS si,
         KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_FLOAT64(CAST(42 AS FLOAT64), 1) AS sf
  FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 40)) AS n,
       UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 3)) AS trial,
       UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, n)) AS x
  GROUP BY n, trial
)

# Compaction boundary p=2: distinct INT64 and constant FLOAT64; retain 4 executions per n.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(n, trial, TO_HEX(si) AS int_hex, TO_HEX(sf) AS float_hex) ORDER BY n, trial)
FROM (
  SELECT n, trial, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 2) AS si,
         KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_FLOAT64(CAST(42 AS FLOAT64), 2) AS sf
  FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 40)) AS n,
       UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 3)) AS trial,
       UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, n)) AS x

# Compaction boundary p=100: distinct INT64 and constant FLOAT64; retain 4 executions per n.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(n, trial, TO_HEX(si) AS int_hex, TO_HEX(sf) AS float_hex) ORDER BY n, trial)
FROM (
  SELECT n, trial, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 100) AS si,
         KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_FLOAT64(CAST(42 AS FLOAT64), 100) AS sf
  FROM UNNEST([278, 279, 280, 281, 282, 559, 560, 561, 1119, 1120, 1121]) AS n,
       UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 3)) AS trial,
       UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, n)) AS x
  GROUP BY n, trial
)

# Weighted singleton p=1: binary decomposition and sampler cutoff; both types.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(w, trial, TO_HEX(si) AS int_hex, TO_HEX(sf) AS float_hex) ORDER BY w, trial)
FROM (
  SELECT w, trial, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1, weight => w) AS si,
         KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_FLOAT64(CAST(x AS FLOAT64), 1, weight => w) AS sf
  FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 15, 16, 17, 31, 32, 33, 4095, 4096, 4097, 8191, 8192, 8193, 16383, 16384, 16385, 1073741823, 1073741824, 1073741825, 2147483647]) AS w,
       UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 3)) AS trial,
       UNNEST([42]) AS x
  GROUP BY w, trial
)

# Weighted singleton p=2: binary decomposition and sampler cutoff; both types.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(w, trial, TO_HEX(si) AS int_hex, TO_HEX(sf) AS float_hex) ORDER BY w, trial)
FROM (
  SELECT w, trial, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 2, weight => w) AS si,
         KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_FLOAT64(CAST(x AS FLOAT64), 2, weight => w) AS sf
  FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 15, 16, 17, 31, 32, 33, 4095, 4096, 4097, 8191, 8192, 8193, 16383, 16384, 16385, 1073741823, 1073741824, 1073741825, 2147483647]) AS w,
       UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 3)) AS trial,
       UNNEST([42]) AS x
  GROUP BY w, trial
)

# Weighted singleton p=1000: binary decomposition and sampler cutoff; both types.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(w, trial, TO_HEX(si) AS int_hex, TO_HEX(sf) AS float_hex) ORDER BY w, trial)
FROM (
  SELECT w, trial, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1000, weight => w) AS si,
         KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_FLOAT64(CAST(x AS FLOAT64), 1000, weight => w) AS sf
  FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 15, 16, 17, 31, 32, 33, 4095, 4096, 4097, 8191, 8192, 8193, 16383, 16384, 16385, 1073741823, 1073741824, 1073741825, 2147483647]) AS w,
       UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 3)) AS trial,
       UNNEST([42]) AS x
  GROUP BY w, trial
)

# Fixed p=1 n=16 state (original) + exact singleton 100 of weight w; w=0 means no second sketch.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(w, trial, TO_HEX(s) AS hex) ORDER BY w, trial)
FROM (
  SELECT w, trial, KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s) AS s

# Fixed p=1 n=16 state (weight_0) + exact singleton 100 of weight w; w=0 means no second sketch.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(w, trial, TO_HEX(s) AS hex) ORDER BY w, trial)
FROM (
  SELECT w, trial, KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s) AS s
  FROM (
    SELECT w, trial, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010001803') AS s
    FROM UNNEST([0, 1, 7, 8, 9, 15, 16, 17]) AS w, UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 7)) AS trial
    UNION ALL
    SELECT w, trial, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1, weight => w) AS s
    FROM UNNEST([1, 7, 8, 9, 15, 16, 17]) AS w,
         UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 7)) AS trial, UNNEST([100]) AS x
    GROUP BY w, trial
  )
  GROUP BY w, trial
)

# Fixed merge pair: n=16 p=1 and same_sampler; repetition can expose random promotion choices.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(trial, TO_HEX(s) AS hex) ORDER BY trial)
FROM (
  SELECT trial, KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s) AS s
  FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 15)) AS trial,
       UNNEST([FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010071803'), FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010071803')]) AS s
  GROUP BY trial

  GROUP BY trial

# Mixed precision: small exact p=1/1000 inputs versus compacted p=1 input; retain source and merged bytes.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(label, TO_HEX(low) AS low_hex, TO_HEX(high) AS high_hex,
                               TO_HEX((SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s) FROM UNNEST([low, high]) AS s)) AS merged_hex) ORDER BY label)
FROM (
  SELECT 'exact_low' AS label,
         FROM_HEX('0871100220048a0710080310011a01012201022a0412020101') AS low,
         FROM_HEX('0871100120048a0711088a1710e8071a01012201012a03120101') AS high
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'compacted_low',
         FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010071803'),
         FROM_HEX('0871100120048a0711088a1710e8071a01012201012a03120101')
)
